title: Volume 1 Chapter 4: Because We're Going to Support You for Life! 4
content: “Is that so?”
“Yeah. I have a lot to explain, but first I have to tell you something. I just made a contract with Ijuuin.”
““Contract?””
Their voices harmonized. As double centers, their timing was perfect.
“Yes. Simply put… I’m going to be supported by Ijuuin from now on.”
Of course, it was a lie. Well, I intended to be supported, but not only by Ijuuin.
“She promised a life of leisure. Since I don’t want to work, I couldn’t refuse.”
“Eh…”
“What are you saying, Kazuma…?”
“I’m also getting money from you two, so I feel bad. Really, sorry!”
I bowed my head, but this was just a pretense to gain favor with Ijuuin here.
“So that means…”
“We’re no longer needed?”

I answered their question with silence.  
They say to deceive your enemies, start with your allies.

I felt bad but decided to exercise my right to remain silent and wait for Yuki-chan to urge homeroom to proceed.  
Spoilers could wait until break time.
That was my judgment, but—
“What the hell! Saying something like that all of a sudden, what do you mean!?”

Arisa, shoulders raised in anger, confronted me.  
Her fierce eyes narrowed further as she charged at me.
“C-calm down, Arisa. There are reasons.”

“There’s no way I can calm down! What? You don’t have enough pocket money? Then I’ll give you more! If you want it, just say so! Saying you want to be supported by other girls out of nowhere makes no sense!”
“That’s…”

I was in trouble. I expected Arisa to get angry, but this was beyond what I imagined.  
She was so furious she was practically raging, and I was taken aback.
“I’ll never accept it! You can’t do anything without me! Kazuma needs me! No matter what you say, I’ll never leave Kazuma!”
“Arisa…”

Tears welled in her eyes.  
The strong, brave girl who sang confidently on stage was nowhere to be seen.
Right now, Arisa was just a girl desperately shouting she didn’t want to lose what was precious.
(Arisa really cares about me this much…)
Seeing her, I felt my chest tighten.

Honestly, I never intended to make her cry.  
I expected to be questioned later, but I hoped she’d just laugh it off as a joke here.

But reality was different.  
Arisa was so upset she was crying in public.  
Seeing that, I wasn’t heartless enough to feel nothing.

I thought her nagging was just worry in disguise.  
Arisa always looked after me and was a kind girl.
But—
“Sorry, Arisa.”
“Ugh! Kazuma!”
“I’ve already decided.”
I had something I absolutely couldn’t give up (not working).
Childhood friends’ feelings <<<< (an unbreakable wall) <<<< Being supported for life
That was my priority and absolute equation.

As I said, I wasn’t heartless toward them.  
But more than that, money and being supported were my top priorities.
“Th-that…”
“I’ll explain later. Don’t think badly. Damenzu is gaining popularity now, so I’ll focus on that for now, okay?”

Actually, my real goal was to appeal to Ijuuin here, then secretly explain the situation later and keep getting money behind the scenes as usual.  
But since I promised, I couldn’t say that in front of Ijuuin.
(Also, if something really happened to them, someone would have to be there for them…)
So, money is better in any case.
While making such unclear excuses in my mind, I steeled myself to deceive them… but—
“I can’t accept this. I just can’t.”

Arisa muttered through clenched teeth.  
Her expression was full of frustration, and her blue eyes held unwavering determination.
“Hey, Arisa…”
“Setsuna, say something! Kazuma must have some terrible reason for saying such nonsense!”

Apparently, Arisa was more stubborn than I thought.  
They planned to convince me together.

But with all due respect, I had no intention of listening to any words.  
Or rather, I didn’t—until—
“We have to confine him.”
“Huh?”
Suddenly, Setsuna said something ominous.
“Kazuma wouldn’t say he wants to leave me. That’s strange. Kazuma is a money-loving scumbag who can’t live without parasitizing me. I’ve tried to believe that. It’s definitely strange.”
“Uh, Setsuna-san?”

“Surely he was deceived. Tempted by money. Kazuma is simple and swallowed the promise to support him. He’s trying to be supported by other girls. We have to confine him. I love scumbag Kazuma, but only I can never abandon him and support him for life. I have to teach him that. I have to make sure he can’t even think of leaving me. Otherwise, it’s no good. Kazuma is mine, and I’m his. I have to discipline him, or scumbag Kazuma won’t understand. Yeah, that’s right. Confinement is the way for us to be happiest.”
With eyes devoid of highlights, the black-haired childhood friend muttered something, and I was genuinely scared.
“Uh, Setsuna? Calm down and let’s talk…”
[img]https://i.imgur.com/s02TAcV.jpeg

“Hey Kazuma? I’m here, so you don’t need other girls serving you, right? I’ll serve you as much as you want. You promised to support me, right? When you said you wanted me to support you, I was really happy. I still remember that time well. I felt from the bottom of my heart that I was needed by you and could stay by your side forever. I never told you before, but when I first met you, I felt it was fate. I knew at first sight that you were my destined person. I thought we’d be together forever. You need me, and I can’t imagine any other boy but you. It’s not logic; it’s instinct. I understood that in my heart. God made us meet. It’s like being told to be with you. You get it now, right? We’re bound by fate. From the day we met, there was only you for me. That’s why I always wanted to be by your side and for you to rely on me. Then we could always be together. I’ll keep that promise. I’ll support you for life. So you have to be supported by me for life too. Only me. Only I will support you, and I’ll accept any Kazuma. So you can be as scummy as you want. You can be selfish. I’ll listen and serve you. No matter what kind of Kazuma you are, you’re still you. Besides, I thought it was good if you got worse because other girls wouldn’t come near you. But then… why do you say you want to be supported by other girls? Does that mean I’m not enough? I’m the only one who can accept your flaws, you know? I’ll give you as much money as you want. You can do whatever you want with me. I’m already yours. I’m fine with anything you do, and I’m happy. I’m an idol, and I’m confident. I feel bad for the fans, but you’re the only one I won’t give up. Because you’re my everything. I have no interest in a world without you. Sorry if that’s heavy. But really, think about it. There’s no other girl like me. Normal girls would be disgusted by your actions. They’d want to break up and give up on you. But I’m different. I think you’re cool even like that. I’m selfish, I know. But it can’t be helped. You’re my destined person. But do you really understand that? I don’t want to say this, but I’m happiest when you want me. I hate to appeal to you myself. Because girls like that seem heavy to you. Scummy Kazuma hates that, right? I’m thinking properly. See? I’m perfect for you. I’m the only one. I’ll make you a useless person. If other girls serve you, that’s a no-no. I’ll make you happy. No one else can serve you but me. Do you get it, Kazuma? Are you listening to me?”

“You say you want to be supported by other girls? Does that mean I’m not enough? I’m the only one who can accept your flaws, you know? I’ll give you as much money as you want. You can do whatever you want with me. I’m already yours. I’m fine with anything you do, and I’m happy. I’m an idol, and I’m confident. I feel bad for the fans, but you’re the only one I won’t give up. Because you’re my everything. I have no interest in a world without you. Sorry if that’s heavy. But really, think about it. There’s no other girl like me. Normal girls would be disgusted by your actions. They’d want to break up and give up on you. But I’m different. I think you’re cool even like that. I’m selfish, I know. But it can’t be helped. You’re my destined person. But do you really understand that? I don’t want to say this, but I’m happiest when you want me. I hate to appeal to you myself. Because girls like that seem heavy to you. Scummy Kazuma hates that, right? I’m thinking properly. See? I’m perfect for you. I’m the only one. I’ll make you a useless person. If other girls serve you, that’s a no-no. I’ll make you happy. No one else can serve you but me. Do you get it, Kazuma? Are you listening to me?”

I was frozen, caught off guard by the flood of words spilling out from Setsuna’s lips. Her eyes, devoid of their usual sparkle, were filled with a fierce determination that sent a chill down my spine.
“Setsuna…” I managed to say, my voice barely above a whisper.

She took a step closer, her black bunny suit rustling softly. “I know you’re a scumbag, Kazuma. But I love you, the real you. The one who’s lazy, selfish, and a little hopeless. That’s why I’ll never let you go. I’ll support you for life, no matter what.”
Arisa, standing beside her in her own bunny suit, nodded solemnly. “We’ll confine you if we have to. You’re ours, Kazuma. Only ours.”
I swallowed hard, realizing that my childhood friends had changed. The playful teasing was gone, replaced by a possessive intensity that was both terrifying and strangely comforting.
“Alright,” I said, trying to steady my voice. “I hear you. I get it.”
“Good,” Setsuna smiled, a devilish glint returning to her eyes. “Because we’re not just your childhood friends anymore. We’re your guardians, your idols, and your lifeline. You’re stuck with us.”
Arisa smirked, crossing her arms. “So don’t even think about running. We’ll make sure you never have to work a day in your life. You’re going to be spoiled rotten, Kazuma.”
I couldn’t help but laugh nervously. “Yeah, yeah. I get it. You two are serious about this.”
“Dead serious,” Setsuna said firmly. “Now, let’s get back to class before Ms. Yuki gets mad.”
As we walked back to our seats, I glanced at the scattered bills still fluttering in the air. Life was about to get a lot more complicated—and a whole lot more interesting.
“That’s why we have to confine you.”
Setsuna suddenly said something ominous.

“Kazuma would never say he wants to leave me. That’s just not right. Kazuma’s a scumbag who loves money and can’t live without parasitizing me. I’ve worked so hard to believe that. He definitely got tricked—tempted by money. Kazuma’s simple-minded, so when someone said they’d support him, he swallowed it whole. He’s trying to get supported by other girls, too. That’s why we have to confine him. I love that scumbag Kazuma, but I have to be the only one to never abandon him and support him for life. I have to teach him that he can’t think about leaving me. If I don’t discipline him so that he understands Kazuma is mine and I’m his, that scumbag Kazuma will never get it. Yeah, that’s right. Confinement is the only way for us to be happiest.”
Her black hair framed her face, her eyes devoid of highlights, mumbling something that made me involuntarily shudder.
“Um, Setsuna? Maybe calm down and let’s talk…”

“Hey, Kazuma? I’m here, so you don’t need to be devoted to other girls, right? I’ll devote myself to you as much as you want. Because you promised to support me, right? When you said you wanted me to support you, I was really happy. I still remember that moment well. I felt from the bottom of my heart that I was needed by you, that I was your destiny. I’d never said this before, but when I first met you, I felt it was fate. I knew at first sight that you were my destined person. I thought we’d be together forever. You can’t do without me, and I can’t imagine any other guy but you. It’s not logic; it’s instinct, I guess. I understood that in my heart. God brought us together. It’s like being told to be with this person. Now you get it, right? We’re bound by fate. From the day we met, there was only you for me. That’s why I always wanted to be by your side and wanted you to rely on me. Then we could be together forever. I’ll definitely keep that promise. I’ll support you for life. So you also have to be supported by me for life. Only me. I’m the only one who will support you, and I’ll accept whatever kind of Kazuma you are. So you can be as much of a scumbag as you want. You can say I’m selfish. I’ll listen to you and devote myself to you. No matter what kind of Kazuma you are, you’re still Kazuma. Besides, I thought it was better if you became a mess because other girls wouldn’t come near you. But then… hey, why do you say you want to be supported by other girls? Does that mean I’m not enough for you? I’m the only one who can accept your bad parts, you know? I’ll give you as much money as you want. You can even do whatever you want with me. I’m already yours. I’m fine with whatever you do to me, and it makes me happy. I’m an idol, and I’m confident about various things. I feel bad for the fans, but I won’t give you up to anyone. Because you’re my everything. I have no interest in a world without you, and I don’t need that. Ah, maybe I said something heavy. Sorry? But please think about it carefully. Because, you know, there’s no girl like me. Normal girls would definitely be disappointed by your actions. They’d want to break up and give up on you. But I’m different. I think you’re cool even as a scumbag. I know I’m convenient for myself, right? It can’t be helped. You’re my destined person. But do you really understand that? I don’t really want to say this kind of thing. I’m happiest when you want me, so I hate appealing to you myself. Because if I’m that kind of girl, you might think I’m heavy. Scumbag Kazuma hates girls like that, right? I’m thinking properly. See? I’m the perfect match for you. There’s no one else. I’ll make you a useless person, so if you’re devoted to other girls, that’s a no-no. I’ll make you happy. I’m the only one who can devote myself to you. Do you understand, Kazuma? Are you listening to me properly?”
Her words poured out in a torrent, filled with passionate devotion and possessiveness that left me speechless.
[img]../image/m179.jpg

“Ah, y-yes. I’m listening, yes,” I nodded reflexively to Setsuna, who was speaking to me in a flat tone without even pausing to breathe, her eyes completely devoid of highlights. By the way, my brain was totally tuning out what she was saying. It would be strange not to be scared by this. Honestly, I was about to pee myself a little.
“So, it’s okay if I confine you, right?”
“Wha—!? Th-that’s a bit much…”
“Confinement. You want it, don’t you?”
“Um…”
“You want me to confine you, right?”
“I wish you’d listen to me too—”
“You want it, right?”
The pressure—the sheer pressure—was overwhelming… Every single word was heavy.
“H-help me, Arisa! Setsuna’s acting really weird!?”
Faced with Setsuna’s terrifying demeanor, I couldn’t help but call out to Arisa for help, but—
“Confinement, huh. That might not be so bad,”
There, standing before me, was my silver-haired childhood friend radiating a pitch-black aura.
“Hey, Kazuma. Remember during the cosplay photoshoot the other day, you said you’d do whatever we asked, right?”
“W-well, I don’t recall promising to do absolutely everything…”
“No, you definitely said it. Even if you didn’t, it doesn’t matter. I’ve put up with your selfishness all this time. So I have the right to be selfish with you too. Right?”
“Uh, well, that’s…”
Isn’t that a bit too much? I wanted to say that, but no words came out. Following Setsuna’s sudden change, Arisa’s transformation completely threw me off.
“I’ve decided. I’m going to confine you, Kazuma. And you’ll become mine. That’s my wish. And I will absolutely make you grant it!”
“Wha—haaa!?”
I was stunned by Arisa’s outrageous declaration following Setsuna’s.

“What the hell are you saying!? You’re not that kind of person! You were a tsundere who couldn’t be honest with her feelings, so why are you suddenly saying something so dangerous!? This Arisa is not normal!”
“I’m not the one who’s crazy. You are. Why are you trying to run away from me? That’s impossible and absolutely unforgivable.”
“…Uh, Arisa-san?”

“I will never let anyone have you. Kazuma is mine. You’re the only one I have, and I can’t imagine you with any other girl. I absolutely hate the idea of giving you to someone else. If I have to give you to anyone, I’d rather keep you just for myself and spend forever together. I won’t let you go, and I won’t leave. Because if I don’t support you for life, you’ll become useless.”
Arisa muttered something under her breath that made her seem untouchable. I think this was a bit beyond typical tsundere behavior. Am I wrong?

“Come to think of it, maybe I’ve been too lenient with you, Kazuma. Even though I knew you were sloppy, I never seriously tried to fix you. That’s probably why you started saying selfish things like wanting to leave me. Yeah, that’s it. I understand everything now. I should have taught you properly once and for all—who you really belong to, down to every inch of your body…”
Arisa’s eyes as she said this were, well, kind of unhinged. They had a bewitching quality, sweet and dreamy, but to me, they were terrifying beyond words.
“A-Arisa-san? P-please don’t say scary things. I don’t think you need to joke like that.”
“I do. Don’t you think a bad childhood friend who tries to go to another girl deserves punishment?”
“N-no, that’s not…”
“It won’t hurt, I promise. In fact… fufu♪”
What’s with the “fufu” laugh!? That’s even scarier! What are you planning to do to me!?
“Well, you can resist if you want, but that’ll just be troublesome. You always run away so easily.”
“Then, won’t you cooperate, Arisa-chan? If it’s the two of us, even if he tries to run, we can catch him quickly. Let’s confine Kazukun together.”
“W-wait, what!? Are you serious!? What kind of outrageous proposal is that to your best friend!?”
“Is that okay?”
“Yeah. I really don’t want to, but this is an emergency. Besides, Arisa-chan is my best friend, so I’ll make an exception. Let’s confine Kazukun together and make him ours.”
Setsuna was clearly saying something crazy, but Arisa didn’t even flinch. On the contrary, she nodded happily and gave Setsuna her approval.
“…Fufu, that’s right. If it’s Setsuna, I’m fine with it. Being with my childhood friend forever has been my dream since long ago.”
“Arisa-chan, you’ve finally become honest with yourself. I think we can get even closer now. But I also want days where I can monopolize Kazukun, so we’ll have to talk about that later.”
“Yes, I’m looking forward to it.”
If you just looked at the atmosphere, it might seem like a beautiful exchange of friendship, but the content was totally off-putting.
Looking around, even our classmates were clearly taken aback. Even the guys who were fans of the Damenzu were grimacing, so it must have been pretty bad.
“Wow… Takanashi-san and Tsukishiro-san really say some things. Confinement, huh. How romantic… I’m so stressed, maybe I should try it too,”
Only Ms. Yuki seemed impressed, but everyone else was backing away, keeping their distance.
The entire classroom was focused on us like a live concert stage, but being caught up in this was a nightmare in every sense.
Amid the obviously dangerous atmosphere, one person who didn’t read the room started moving toward Setsuna.
It goes without saying who it was: the blonde lady, Reika Ijuuin.
“Please wait, Setsuna-sama! Arisa-sama!”
With a determined look, Ijuuin stood in front of Setsuna and spread her arms to hide me from view.

“Both of you! Please stop fixating on Kazuma-sama! You are top idols who should be at the pinnacle of the idol world! It’s time to leave Kazuma-sama behind and walk the right path! Please forget about him! I, Reika Ijuuin, will take responsibility and support Kazuma-sama for life on your behalf!”
“Therefore, please focus on your activities with Damenzu from now on—”
““Annoying!””
A backhand strike. Both of them casually swung their hands and lightly brushed Ijuuin aside.
With a loud crash, Ijuuin fell to the floor.
“Ojou-sama!?”
Himeno Ichinose immediately rushed over to catch her, but I thought I saw a faint look of infatuation on her face. Maybe it was just my imagination.
“Hey! What the hell are you two doing!?”
That was literally a reckless act against a future major sponsor.
I was panicking at the violence from my childhood friends right before my eyes, but as if nothing happened, Setsuna turned her gaze to the other childhood friend.
“Then it’s settled, right, Arisa-chan? Kazukun is ours.”
“Yes, Setsuna. Then, for our happiness, shall we begin?”
I looked at Arisa, who normally was so spirited, but now her eyes, like Setsuna’s, had lost their highlights.
“Eek…”
“Okay, Kazukun?”
“Hey, Kazuma?”
And the gaze of my two childhood friends was fixed on me.
“Um, Setsuna-san? Arisa-san?”
“You don’t want to work, right?”
“You don’t want to work, do you?”
Their voices, heard simultaneously, carried a deathly tone that felt like it came from the depths of hell—hardly fitting for idols.
Sensing something I couldn’t resist, I nodded without thinking.
“Y-yes.”
““You don’t want to work for your whole life, right?””
“Y-yeah.”
““You want us to support you for your whole life, right?””
To their questions, all I could do was nod. My legs were shaking like a newborn fawn.
I felt like a sacrifice being offered in a devilish ritual.
““Then it’s just us, right?””
“H-huh?”
“Only we can support Kazukun, Kazuma.”
“Then, you don’t need any other girls. Right?”
The two of them leaned in close.
Though their faces were usually exquisitely beautiful like goddesses, now they looked like demons.
“W-well, I thought it might be better to have more people supporting me, just in case…”
““N-o-t-n-e-e-d-e-d, r-i-g-h-t?””
There were bottomless dark eyes staring at me.
Terrifying. That was my simple impression.
“Y-yes…”
“Good♪”
“I knew you’d nod, Kazuma.”
I couldn’t resist their voices.
The moment I nodded, they stepped back and spoke in bright voices, but they felt like very frightening beings.
“Hey, Kazukun.”
“Kazuma.”
“Y-yes!”
Answering in a high-pitched voice, they smiled broadly.
““We will support you forever, forever—!”
For someone like me who doesn’t want to work, this was a very welcome declaration.
“We’ll never let you escape♪ …Absolutely.”
“You’re going to be supported by us. Got it, Kazuma?”
I wondered if maybe I was the one being parasitized. But that’s a story for another time.
